title: A Court of Mist and Fury
author: Sarah J. Maas
summary: The second book in the series opens with a heroine struggling to recover from what happened Under the Mountain. A bargain pulls her toward a new court and a very different group of allies, while a larger war gets closer.
readIf: you finished the first book and want its mood to deepen, with more heat and a wider cast.
skipIf: you haven't read the first book, since this assumes it and its plot is not standalone.

pairings.reason: The next book in the series, a bigger and more war-focused continuation.
Same author and a similar mix of romance, court intrigue and a growing war, for a different heroine.
Another fae-court story full of danger and manipulation, with a younger and sharper edge.
